portada.label: Cover
portada.description: A large cover photo with the search bar on top.

editorial.label: Editorial
editorial.description: Big headline next to the photo and wider cards with a description.

compacto.label: Compact
compacto.description: No cover photo. Shows many properties at a glance.

dividido.label: Split
dividido.description: Half in your colour with the headline and search, half with the cover photo.

mosaico.label: Mosaic
mosaico.description: A photo collage at the top, chosen in Cover, and the first property featured large.

editorial.label: Editorial
editorial.description: Serif with character, like a magazine.

location.label: Location
location.description: An area with a photo, text and its properties. Ideal for Ibiza, Greece or your neighbourhood.

promo.label: Promotion
promo.description: Properties with a label like “15% OFF” or “Seasonal offer”.

featured.label: Featured properties
featured.description: Your own selection: the newest, beachfront, the most requested.

destinations.label: Destinations
destinations.description: Several areas at once, each with its photo. Tapping one filters the listing.

text.label: Text and image
text.description: Tell something of your own: your services, valuations, how you work.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.description: An invitation with a button, like “Want to sell your property?”.

design.title: Design
design.description: The overall shape of the home page. You can use one on computers and another on phones.
design.sameAsDesktopHint: Turn it off to pick a different design for phones only.

color.title: Colour
color.description: For buttons, links and details. The rest of the site stays white and grey.

cover.mosaicDescription: The four cover photos, in this order; the first one is shown large. If you don't pick any, your properties' photos are used.
cover.photoDescription: The main image of your page. Best landscape and at least 1920 px wide.
cover.none: No cover: your colour is used.
cover.heroTitleHint: If you leave it empty, the sample one is used.
cover.heroSubtitlePlaceholder: Houses and flats for sale and rent on the coast.

blocksPanel.title: Blocks
blocksPanel.description: Your own sections between the cover and the listing: destinations like Ibiza or Greece, or promotions with featured properties.

agency.aboutDescription: A paragraph about who you are and how you work.
agency.showAbout: Show the section on the site
agency.aboutPlaceholder: We're a family estate agency with 20 years in the area…
agency.contactDescription: Shown in the footer and the contact section. The email is changed in Settings.
agency.whatsappHint: With country code. Turns on the “Message us on WhatsApp” button.

location.title: Ibiza
location.text: Turquoise coves, white villages and sunsets. We have villas and flats all over the island.

promo.title: Summer on the coast
promo.text: Book before 30 November and get 15% off stays of a week or more.

text.title: Free valuation of your property
text.text: We tell you what it's worth on today's market and how to sell it faster.

cta.title: Want to sell your property?
cta.text: We're with you from the valuation to completion.

picker.empty: You don't have any published properties yet.

blocks.title: Title
blocks.zoneHint: Counts properties whose neighbourhood, region or country matches this area.
blocks.max: You've reached the maximum of {max} blocks.
blocks.addTitle: Which block do you want to add?

mosaic.dialogDescription: Pick a photo from your properties or upload an image.
mosaic.empty: Your properties don't have photos yet.

exit.title: You have unsaved changes
exit.body: If you leave now, the changes you haven't saved to your site will be lost.
